description: This file defines functions for loading include patterns and creating a scoped Vitest configuration for extension provider tests, exporting a default configuration that is used in the testing setup.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns from the environment variables, defaulting to process.env, by calling loadPatternListFromEnv with a specific environment variable name.

methods.name: export function createExtensionProvidersVitestConfig( createExtensionProvidersVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a Vitest configuration scoped to extension providers, using include patterns from environment or default roots, and setting specific options such as directory, environment, test setup files, and enabling passing with no tests.
